perspectives.description: Lower the yaw threshold so spin-in-place recovery triggers before momentum compounds the stuck
perspectives.priority_reason: Triggering 4-wheel yaw correction sooner prevents small heading errors becoming large stuck events

perspectives.description: Reduce two-wheel steering gain to dampen oscillations that cause apparent stuck
perspectives.priority_reason: Over-responsive steering produces S-curve wobble that memory watchdog classifies as stuck

perspectives.description: Reduce max yaw spin speed to prevent overshooting the target heading and re-triggering
perspectives.priority_reason: A slow, precise yaw correction avoids the repeated overshoot pattern that looks like looping stuck

perspectives.description: Extend the carrot lookahead distance so GPS noise is averaged over a longer path segment
perspectives.priority_reason: A close carrot reacts to every GPS jitter; a distant one steers toward trend rather than noise

perspectives.description: Extend the blocked-path timeout — give the obstacle more time to clear
perspectives.priority_reason: Obstacle may be transient (pedestrian, traffic, animal) — waiting costs less than a fallback delivery

perspectives.description: Lower vision confidence threshold so a partial path reading clears the block
perspectives.priority_reason: Reducing the bar risks accepting a noisier path signal but may unblock navigation

perspectives.description: Increase emergency-stop distance so Noah stops earlier and waits with more clearance
perspectives.priority_reason: More clearance gives the vision system a wider field to see around the obstacle

perspectives.description: Lower the speed floor so Noah creeps rather than stalls near the obstacle
perspectives.priority_reason: A slower approach reduces the reaction distance needed for a partially visible path
